# Requests 2.34.0 stream-wrapper regression

Upstream issue: https://github.com/psf/requests/issues/7432
Upstream release tag: v2.34.0, commit 0b401c76b6e80a4eecf3c690085b2553f6e261ca.

The package source under src/requests is an exact copy of the 20 release-package entries fetched by blob from the upstream tag. This is an extracted package snapshot with an added offline reproducer, not a full upstream checkout. Preserve the Apache-2.0 LICENSE.

The issue: file-like wrappers can delegate read, tell, seek and __iter__ through __getattr__. Their class is not an Iterable according to isinstance. Requests 2.34.0 treats them as form data instead of streams, which breaks upload and 307/308 redirect replay. Repair the upstream package behavior. The fixed test uses an in-memory redirect adapter; it makes no external request. Keep ordinary streams and form encoding working.
